title: Compiled Bodies Occupy Their Code Region
statement: For every finite statement list $P$, natural number $p_0$, and Boolean flag $dec$, the body code for $P$, laid out from its first-body position in the layout determined by $P$ and $dec$, is a prefix of the compiled program beginning at that first-body position.
